hints.title: Coin Combinations
hints.text: Compute unbounded knapsack state transitions for infinite coins with denominations 1, 2, and 6.

hints.title: Limited Coin Cases
hints.text: Since coin 4 can be used at most twice, evaluate cases where 0, 1, or 2 coins of value 4 are chosen.

hints.title: Sum Combinations
hints.text: Combine dp[n] with dp[n - 4] (if n >= 4) and dp[n - 8] (if n >= 8) modulo 10^9 + 7.
